title: Custom CSV Mass Spec Sample Preparation
author: Opentrons
materials: Discard tip into the trash bin.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Load the CSV file (One‑Plate or Two‑Plate format) and set all protocol options: sample volume, acetonitrile transfer flag, P300 single‑channel and multichannel mount positions, sample aspiration/dispense flow rate, MeCN aspiration flow rate, temperature‑module usage (slots 3 and 6 if needed), dispense height (mm), PL blowout height (mm), airgap volume (µL), reservoir column for MeCN, MeCN dilution slot, and the multichannel tip‑pick‑up start column (1‑12).

steps.title: Aspirate sample with air gap
steps.instruction: Using the single‑channel P300 pipette, aspirate 50 µL of the sample from the tube rack, then aspirate an additional 20 µL of air to create an air gap.

steps.title: Dispense sample into destination well
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated sample into the well specified in column A of Plate 1 (e.g., A1) at the defined dispense height, then perform a blowout at the specified PL blowout height. If a second plate is used, repeat the dispense into the same well on Plate 2.

substeps.instruction: Move to the destination well (e.g., A1 of Plate 1).
Blow out at the set PL blowout height.
If using two plates, repeat dispense and blowout in the corresponding well of Plate 2.

steps.title: Discard tip
steps.instruction: Eject the used tip into the trash bin.

steps.title: Repeat for all CSV wells
steps.instruction: Iterate the aspirate‑air‑gap, dispense‑blowout, and tip‑discard sequence for every well entry listed in the CSV file.

steps.title: Transfer acetonitrile to plates
steps.instruction: Pick up a fresh tip with the multichannel pipette, aspirate 100 µL of acetonitrile from the designated reservoir column, and dispense into every well of the plate(s) at the configured flow rates and dispense height.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a multichannel tip (starting column as set).
Aspirate 100 µL MeCN from the specified reservoir.
Dispense 100 µL MeCN into all destination wells.

steps.title: Discard tip after acetonitrile
steps.instruction: Eject the multichannel tip into the trash bin.
